summary: The reported TCP backlog race is representable as two kernel contexts, but the patch annotates sk_rcvbuf/sk_sndbuf reads while the reported tcp_recvmsg line reads sk_backlog.tail.

dataset_decision.reason: The fix commit patches sk_add_backlog caller reads of sk_rcvbuf/sk_sndbuf, but the embedded KCSAN stack's peer access in tcp_recvmsg is the backlog-tail check at tcp.c:2048. That access pair does not match the patched behavior, so using it as ground truth would train on a sibling or benign race rather than the actual patch.

call_chain.evidence: KCSAN write stack reports tcp_add_backlog and merged.ll defines it.
KCSAN read stack reports tcp_recvmsg and tcp.ll was repaired into merged.ll.

interleaving: The receive softirq appends an skb to sk->sk_backlog through tcp_add_backlog/sk_add_backlog.
A task in tcp_recvmsg checks sk->sk_backlog.tail while deciding whether to break out of receive processing.
This two-context pair is in the KCSAN report, but the patch does not annotate this backlog-tail access.

ground_truth_access.object: ambiguous: reported struct sock::sk_backlog.tail, patched struct sock::sk_rcvbuf/sk_sndbuf
ground_truth_access.required_ordering: Uncertain: the reported backlog-tail pair differs from the sk_rcvbuf/sk_sndbuf access family actually annotated by the patch.

vulnerability_surface.why_relevant: The visible KCSAN pair centers on sk_backlog.tail, but the fix changes lockless reads of sk_rcvbuf/sk_sndbuf in backlog admission. The core surface cannot be assigned to one variable without contradicting either the report or the patch.

aliases.name: sk->sk_backlog.tail
aliases.evidence: Reported write site appends an skb to the socket backlog.

aliases.name: sk->sk_backlog.tail
aliases.evidence: Reported read site checks whether the backlog is empty.

aliases.name: sk->sk_rcvbuf
aliases.evidence: Patch changes the backlog limit calculation to READ_ONCE(sk->sk_rcvbuf).

thread_a.evidence: tcp_add_backlog receives the socket directly and both appends backlog and computes the backlog limit.

thread_b.evidence: tcp_recvmsg reads the same socket's backlog tail in the reported line.

published_by: TCP socket file descriptor and network receive path

notes: Marked low confidence because the patch/report mismatch prevents a reliable primary object choice.

coverage.analysis_conclusion: All patched source files plus repaired tcp.c are present in source/IR, but the case is excluded because the reported access pair does not align with the patch's annotated object.

patch_hunks: 8265792bf887 adds READ_ONCE around sk_rcvbuf/sk_sndbuf reads in tcp_add_backlog and sk_add_backlog callers.
indirect_edges: KCSAN stack reports receive softirq path into tcp_add_backlog and userspace read path into tcp_recvmsg.
entry_discovery_log: merged.ll defines tcp_add_backlog and tcp_recvmsg after repair.
repair_commands: Compiled tcp.c with clang-15 and linked it with existing sock/tcp_ipv4/llc/sctp/tipc/x25 IR using external llvm-link.
notes: Manual line check of 8265792bf887^:net/ipv4/tcp.c shows reported tcp_recvmsg line 2048 is sk->sk_backlog.tail, not sk_rcvbuf/sk_sndbuf.
